relations: The dark object intruding from the left obscures the view before the hammer strikes the sphere.
The hammer descending onto the sphere causes an impact that throws a large dust cloud outward.
The impact leaves the hammer on the plate while the sphere is no longer visible.
The hammer's impact produces a near-white dust burst, leaving a faint vertical silhouette in the haze.
caption: Under a clear blue sky on rocky ground, a polished cylindrical hammer head on a yellow arm appears in a tilted close view amid dust and debris. The horizon and a tree swing across the frame as a dark object intrudes from the left and obscures much of the view. A low wide angle shows a dark sphere centered on a metal plate, with the hammer descending from above before striking it. The impact throws a large dust cloud outward, after which the hammer remains on the plate while the sphere is no longer visible. In a side view, the sphere sits on a rail between two small tripod cameras as the hammer comes down and erupts into dense dust. The hammer remains amid settling dust and flying debris, while the cameras stay at the edges of the metal platform. Another close side angle shows the sphere beside one tripod camera before the hammer impacts, producing a near-white burst and leaving a faint vertical silhouette in the haze.
